replays a scripted sequence of hand observations.\"\"\"\n35\t    egresses = False\n36\t\n37\t    def __init__(self, sequence: List[List[Hand]]):\n38\t        self._seq = list(sequence)\n39\t        self._i = 0\n40\t\n41\t    def detect(self, image) -> List[Hand]:\n42\t        if self._i >= len(self._seq):\n43\t            return []\n44\t        obs = self._seq[self._i]\n45\t        self._i += 1\n46\t        return obs\n47\t\n48\t\n49\tclass ScriptedGestures:\n50\t    \"\"\"Replays a scripted sequence of GestureReadings (bypasses the model).\"\"\"\n51\t    def __init__(self, readings: List[GestureReading]):\n52\t        self._seq = list(readings)\n53\t        self._i = 0\n54\t\n55\t    def classify(self, hands: List[Hand]) -> GestureReading:\n56\t        if self._i >= len(self._seq):\n57\t            return GestureReading(\"neutral\", 0.0)\n58\t        r = self._seq[self._i]\n59\t        self._i += 1\n60\t        return r\n61\t\n62\t\n63\tclass RecordingInputBackend:\n64\t    \"\"\"Records every injection call; touches NO OS. The double every gate test drives.\"\"\"\n65\t    def __init__(self):\n66\t        self.calls: List[tuple] = []\n67\t\n68\t    def move(self, dx, dy): self.calls.append((\"move\", dx, dy))\n69\t    def click(self, button=\"left\"): self.calls.append((\"click\", button))\n70\t    def scroll(self, dx, dy): self.calls.append((\"scroll\", dx, dy))\n71\t    def type(self, text): self.calls.append((\"type\", text))\n72\t    def combo(self, keys): self.calls.append((\"combo\", keys))\n73\t"}]},"uuid":"6b09ecc4-09f1-4ff4-95f9-9d1e79f7360d","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:05.165Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"330146e7-afe4-4f5a-959d-3ad1a4c53b79","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"26c90da5-60c5-4743-823e-21bdc03e9d7a","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01YF1jMCJRXd3EFAYqZCe7fE","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The live gesture-control daemon (Phase 8, WS-F F7) — camera stream → landmarks → classify → FSM →\n2\tSessionGate, mirroring `voice/run.py run_mic`. Arms the session on start (indicator lit), disarms in a\n3\t`finally` (indicator cleared even on crash). Graceful fallbacks; components are injectable so the\n4\twhole loop runs deterministically on scripted doubles with no camera/model/OS input.\"\"\"\n5\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n6\t\n7\tfrom typing import Optional\n8\t\n9\tfrom .pipeline import GesturePipeline\n10\tfrom .session import SessionGate\n11\t\n12\t\n13\tdef run_gesture(*, store=None, owner_key=None, source=None, landmarker=None, classifier=None,\n14\t                backend=None, pipeline=None, gate=None, max_frames: Optional[int] = None) -> int:\n15\t    \"\"\"Run the loop; returns the number of frames processed. Injectable for tests.\"\"\"\n16\t    if store is None:\n17\t        from ..spine.store import SpineStore\n18\t        store = SpineStore()\n19\t    if source is None:\n20\t        from ..perception.camera_stream import CameraStreamSource\n21\t        source = CameraStreamSource()\n22\t    if landmarker is None:\n23\t        from .landmark import OnnxHandLandmarker\n24\t        landmarker = OnnxHandLandmarker()\n25\t    # STRICT fail-closed egress gate (Phase 9 W2-H): this loop injects HID off a live camera stream,\n26\t    # so it refuses UNLESS the landmarker is EXPLICITLY on-box (`egresses is False`) — stricter than\n27\t    # perceive's default-safe `getattr(..., \"egresses\", False)` form, because an unset/unknown flag\n28\t    # here would mean streaming owner PIXELS off-box while driving the pointer. This gate refuses a\n29\t    # model that would EGRESS owner imagery; a future `RemoteLandmarker` with `egresses=False` (an\n30\t    # authorized INBOUND landmark-DATA stream over the owner's own tunnel) is a DISTINCT,\n31\t    # separately-authorized thing — it egresses nothing and passes this gate.\n32\t    if getattr(landmarker, \"egresses\", True) is not False:\n33\t        store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n34\t                     payload={\"signal\": \"gesture.refused\", \"decision\": \"refused\", \"tier\": \"A0\",\n35\t                              \"reason\": \"landmark model would egress owner imagery — the gesture \"\n36\t                                        \"loop is on-box only\"})\n37\t        return 0  # inject NOTHING; never armed\n38\t    if classifier is None:\n39\t        from .features import RuleClassifier\n40\t        classifier = RuleClassifier()\n41\t    if backend is None:\n42\t        from ..platform import input_backend\n43\t        backend = input_backend()\n44\t    pipe = pipeline or GesturePipeline()\n45\t    g = gate or SessionGate(store, backend, owner_key=owner_key)\n46\t    g.arm(owner_key=owner_key)\n47\t    n = 0\n48\t    try:\n49\t        for frame in source.frames():\n50\t            reading = classifier.classify(landmarker.detect(frame))\n51\t            intent = pipe.on_frame(reading)\n52\t            if intent is not None:\n53\t                g.handle(intent)\n54\t            n += 1\n55\t            if max_frames is not None and n >= max_frames:\n56\t                break\n57\t    finally:\n58\t        g.disarm()\n59\t    return n\n60\t"}]},"uuid":"7548143e-c36e-432c-ae2a-caf5ebb7ad28","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:05.676Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"26c90da5-60c5-4743-823e-21bdc03e9d7a","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"4a95ab63-6fa8-4ace-8788-4a285fa865e2","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WyKWUR6iczuvM6iipRPZsL","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SessionGate (Phase 8, WS-F, THE KEYSTONE) — the ONLY authority that injects input, and only inside\n2\tan owner-armed session. Two enforcement layers so a gesture can NEVER trigger an unintended action:\n3\t\n4\t  Layer 1 — the SESSION: `arm()` REQUIRES the owner key (it cannot be armed without the owner\n5\t  identity) and appends a signed `gesture.session_armed` record — the tamper-evident AUDIT proof-of-\n6\t  authorization, indicator-lit. The INJECTION gate itself is the live in-memory session, held ONLY by\n7\t  the owner's own running daemon process; it is BOUNDED by a TTL and ended by disarm / hand-loss /\n8\t  expiry. Injection is REFUSED with no live session.\n9\t\n10\t  Layer 2 — per intent, the tier is DERIVED from the WARDEN oracle (`hid.*` names): A1 (pointer\n11\t  move/click/scroll/drag) injects within the session; A2 (type/combo/app.launch) is QUEUED for a\n12\t  verified owner/device approval bound to `sha256(session_id|tool|args)` and NEVER auto-injected — so\n13\t  a gesture alone can never type a password or launch an app.\n14\t\n15\tOnly arm/disarm + DISCRETE actions (click/scroll/drag injected; type/launch queued) hit the spine —\n16\tper-frame pointer MOVES are telemetry (30 FPS records would DoS the append-only log).\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\timport time\n20\timport uuid\n21\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n22\tfrom typing import Optional\n23\t\n24\tfrom ..agents.base import Tier\n25\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n26\tfrom .components import InputBackend\n27\tfrom .types import GestureIntent\n28\t\n29\tSESSION_ARMED = \"gesture.session_armed\"\n30\tSESSION_DISARMED = \"gesture.session_disarmed\"\n31\tACTION_SIGNAL = \"gesture.action\"\n32\t\n33\tINTENT_TOOL = {\n34\t    \"move\": \"hid.pointer.move\", \"click\": \"hid.pointer.click\",\n35\t    \"scroll_left\": \"hid.pointer.scroll\", \"scroll_right\": \"hid.pointer.scroll\",\n36\t    \"drag\": \"hid.pointer.drag\", \"type\": \"hid.type\", \"combo\": \"hid.combo\", \"launch\": \"hid.app.launch\",\n37\t}\n38\t\n39\t\n40\t@dataclass\n41\tclass Session:\n42\t    session_id: str\n43\t    live: bool = True\n44\t    expires_at: float = 0.0            # wallclock deadline — a session is BOUNDED, never indefinite\n45\t\n46\t    def expired(self, now: float) -> bool:\n47\t        return self.expires_at > 0.0 and now >= self.expires_at\n48\t\n49\t\n50\tclass SessionGate:\n51\t    def __init__(self, store, backend: InputBackend, *, classifier=None, owner_key=None):\n52\t        self.store = store\n53\t        self.backend = backend\n54\t        self._classifier = classifier\n55\t        self._owner_key = owner_key\n56\t        self.session: Optional[Session] = None\n57\t\n58\t    def _cls(self):\n59\t        if self._classifier is None:\n60\t            from ..agents.kernel_classify import KernelClassifier\n61\t            self._classifier = KernelClassifier()\n62\t        return self._classifier\n63\t\n64\t    # --- Layer 1: the owner-armed session ---------------------------------------------------------\n65\t    def arm(self, *, owner_key=None, ttl_seconds: float = 1800.0) -> Session:\n66\t        from ..governor.authn import signed_payload\n67\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair\n68\t        ok = owner_key if owner_key is not None else (self._owner_key or owner_keypair())\n69\t        if ok is None:\n70\t            raise RuntimeError(\"cannot arm a gesture session without the owner key (BLOCK-3)\")\n71\t        sid = uuid.uuid4().hex\n72\t        core = {\"signal\": SESSION_ARMED, \"session_id\": sid}\n73\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n74\t                          payload={**signed_payload(core, ok), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n75\t                                   \"ttl_seconds\": ttl_seconds,\n76\t                                   \"summary\": \"gesture session ARMED (indicator lit — opt-in)\"})\n77\t        self.session = Session(sid, live=True, expires_at=time.time() + ttl_seconds)\n78\t        return self.session\n79\t\n80\t    def disarm(self) -> None:\n81\t        if self.session is not None:\n82\t            self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n83\t                              payload={\"signal\": SESSION_DISARMED, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n84\t                                       \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\", \"summary\": \"gesture session DISARMED\"})\n85\t            self.session.live = False\n86\t        self.session = None\n87\t\n88\t    # --- Layer 2: per-intent tier gate ------------------------------------------------------------\n89\t    def handle(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> dict:\n90\t        \"\"\"Authorize + act on ONE intent. Returns a verdict dict. Injection ONLY inside a live session\n91\t        and ONLY for A1 tools; A2+ queues for approval and injects NOTHING; a danger name → refused.\"\"\"\n92\t        if intent.kind == \"hand_lost\":\n93\t            self.disarm()\n94\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"hand lost — session disarmed\"}\n95\t        if self.session is None or not self.session.live:\n96\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"no armed session — injection refused\"}\n97\t        if self.session.expired(time.time()):             # BLOCK-2: a session is bounded, never indefinite\n98\t            self.disarm()\n99\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"session expired — disarmed\"}\n100\t        tool = INTENT_TOOL.get(intent.kind)\n101\t        if tool is None:\n102\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": f\"unknown intent {intent.kind}\"}\n103\t        tier = self._cls().classify(tool)                 # DERIVED, fail-closed A3 on any error\n104\t        args = f\"{intent.dx:.4f},{intent.dy:.4f},{intent.arg}\"\n105\t        if tier <= Tier.A1:\n106\t            self._inject(intent)\n107\t            # BLOCK-1: log the DISCRETE A1 injections that actually take effect (click/scroll/drag);\n108\t            # per-frame `move` is telemetry (logging it at 30 FPS would DoS the append-only spine).\n109\t            if intent.kind != \"move\":\n110\t                self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n111\t                                  payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"auto\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n112\t                                           \"tool\": tool, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n113\t                                           \"summary\": f\"gesture {tool} injected\"})\n114\t            return {\"injected\": True, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool}\n115\t        # A2/A3 → QUEUE an approval bound to this exact action; inject NOTHING\n116\t        token = sha256_hex(f\"{self.session.session_id}|{tool}|{args}\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n117\t        seq = self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"PERCEPTION\",\n118\t                                payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"queued\",\n119\t                                         \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n120\t                                         \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token, \"args\": args,\n121\t                                         \"subject\": f\"gesture action {tool} (awaiting approval)\"})\n122\t        return {\"injected\": False, \"queued\": seq, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token}\n123\t\n124\t    def _inject(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> None:\n125\t        b = self.backend\n126\t        if intent.kind == \"move\" or intent.kind == \"drag\":\n127\t            b.move(intent.dx, intent.dy)\n128\t        elif intent.kind == \"click\":\n129\t            b.click()\n130\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_left\":\n131\t            b.scroll(-1, 0)\n132\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_right\":\n133\t            b.scroll(1, 0)\n134\t"}]},"uuid":"2fc51139-8983-4cb6-b22f-856f3e9de998","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:06.039Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4a95ab63-6fa8-4ace-8788-4a285fa865e2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"4ec79eed-0c57-4a89-b3b9-8362794c4c52","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01M19sXupqmdDhXjtzx6JZu9","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"GesturePipeline (Phase 8, WS-F) — a frame-driven, debounced intent FSM, a structural copy of\n2\t`voice/pipeline.py`: timing in FRAME COUNTS (not wallclock), hysteresis so one noisy frame fires\n3\tNOTHING. `on_frame(reading) -> Optional[GestureIntent]`. Fail-safe by construction:\n4\t\n5\t  • a POINT pose drives continuous pointer `move` intents (deadzone-filtered);\n6\t  • a discrete gesture (pinch→click, swipe→scroll, spread→launch, twofinger→type) fires ONLY after\n7\t    `confirm_frames` consecutive identical HIGH-confidence, HIGH-margin readings, then a cooldown;\n8\t  • low confidence OR a small top1−top2 margin ⇒ NEUTRAL ⇒ counter resets ⇒ nothing fires (ambiguity\n9\t    does nothing);\n10\t  • `hand_lost_frames` of no-hand/neutral ⇒ a `hand_lost` intent so the session AUTO-DISARMS.\n11\t\n12\tThe FSM decides INTENT; authorization (a live armed session + the WARDEN tier) is the SessionGate's\n13\tjob — so this stays a pure, deterministically-testable state machine.\"\"\"\n14\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n15\t\n16\tfrom typing import Optional\n17\t\n18\tfrom .types import GestureIntent, GestureReading\n19\t\n20\t# discrete gesture label → intent kind (a POINT pose is the continuous move driver, handled separately)\n21\tDISCRETE = {\n22\t    \"pinch\": \"click\", \"swipe_left\": \"scroll_left\", \"swipe_right\": \"scroll_right\",\n23\t    \"spread\": \"launch\", \"twofinger\": \"type\", \"grab\": \"drag\",\n24\t}\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tclass GesturePipeline:\n28\t    def __init__(self, *, confirm_frames: int = 4, cooldown_frames: int = 6, hand_lost_frames: int = 8,\n29\t                 conf_min: float = 0.6, margin_min: float = 0.15, deadzone: float = 0.002):\n30\t        self.confirm_frames = confirm_frames\n31\t        self.cooldown_frames = cooldown_frames\n32\t        self.hand_lost_frames = hand_lost_frames\n33\t        self.conf_min = conf_min\n34\t        self.margin_min = margin_min\n35\t        self.deadzone = deadzone\n36\t        self._label: Optional[str] = None\n37\t        self._count = 0\n38\t        self._cool = 0\n39\t        self._lost = 0\n40\t\n41\t    def on_frame(self, reading: Optional[GestureReading]) -> Optional[GestureIntent]:\n42\t        if self._cool > 0:\n43\t            self._cool -= 1\n44\t        # no hand / explicit neutral → count toward auto-disarm; a discrete streak is broken\n45\t        if reading is None or not reading.label or reading.label == \"neutral\":\n46\t            self._label, self._count = None, 0\n47\t            self._lost += 1\n48\t            if self._lost >= self.hand_lost_frames:\n49\t                self._lost = 0\n50\t                return GestureIntent(\"hand_lost\")\n51\t            return None\n52\t        self._lost = 0\n53\t        # AMBIGUITY → nothing (fail-safe): a single noisy or low-margin frame cannot fire\n54\t        if reading.confidence < self.conf_min or reading.margin < self.margin_min:\n55\t            self._label, self._count = None, 0\n56\t            return None\n57\t        if reading.label == \"point\":                       # continuous pointer control\n58\t            self._label, self._count = None, 0\n59\t            if abs(reading.dx) < self.deadzone and abs(reading.dy) < self.deadzone:\n60\t                return None\n61\t            return GestureIntent(\"move\", dx=reading.dx, dy=reading.dy)\n62\t        # a discrete gesture: require `confirm_frames` consecutive identical readings (hysteresis)\n63\t        if reading.label == self._label:\n64\t            self._count += 1\n65\t        else:\n66\t            self._label, self._count = reading.label, 1\n67\t        if self._count >= self.confirm_frames and self._cool == 0:\n68\t            self._count = 0\n69\t            self._cool = self.cooldown_frames\n70\t            kind = DISCRETE.get(reading.label, \"none\")\n71\t            return GestureIntent(kind, arg=reading.label) if kind != \"none\" else None\n72\t        return None\n73\t"}]},"uuid":"d8abb02f-9d44-4481-aaac-a95891066cf5","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:11.576Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4ec79eed-0c57-4a89-b3b9-8362794c4c52","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"b60fb093-8b0c-4268-b1de-3b6623b20660","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011CUkEYuZGGdmHm828fLdE7","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Landmark features + a from-foundation classifier (Phase 8, WS-F F4). `invariant_features` turns 21\n2\traw keypoints into a TRANSLATION/SCALE/ROTATION-invariant vector: recenter to the wrist (kp0), scale\n3\tby the wrist→middle-MCP span (kp9), canonicalize rotation to that axis. Invariance is a hard,\n4\ttestable property (translate/scale/rotate the same hand → identical features) and is what makes the\n5\tclassifier robust. `RuleClassifier` is a working baseline over the features (extended-finger counting\n6\t+ pinch distance); a trained MLP/TCN over these features (exported ONNX/npz, `train/` offline) is the\n7\tdocumented upgrade behind the same `GestureModel` Protocol.\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\timport math\n11\tfrom typing import List\n12\t\n13\tfrom .types import GestureReading, Hand\n14\t\n15\t_TIPS = (4, 8, 12, 16, 20)\n16\t_PIPS = (2, 6, 10, 14, 18)\n17\t\n18\t\n19\tdef _dist(a, b) -> float:\n20\t    return math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tdef invariant_features(hand: Hand) -> List[float]:\n24\t    pts = [(lm[0], lm[1]) for lm in hand.landmarks]\n25\t    if len(pts) < 21:\n26\t        return []\n27\t    wx, wy = pts[0]\n28\t    rel = [(x - wx, y - wy) for x, y in pts]              # translation-invariant (recenter to wrist)\n29\t    span = math.hypot(rel[9][0], rel[9][1]) or 1e-6\n30\t    rel = [(x / span, y / span) for x, y in rel]          # scale-invariant (wrist→mid-MCP span)\n31\t    theta = math.atan2(rel[9][1], rel[9][0])\n32\t    cos, sin = math.cos(-theta), math.sin(-theta)\n33\t    rot = [(x * cos - y * sin, x * sin + y * cos) for x, y in rel]   # rotation-canonicalized\n34\t    out: List[float] = []\n35\t    for x, y in rot:\n36\t        out += [x, y]\n37\t    return out\n38\t\n39\t\n40\tclass RuleClassifier:\n41\t    \"\"\"A working, dependency-free static-pose classifier over the invariant geometry.\"\"\"\n42\t    def classify(self, hands: List[Hand]) -> GestureReading:\n43\t        if not hands:\n44\t            return GestureReading(\"neutral\", 0.0)\n45\t        h = hands[0]\n46\t        pts = [(lm[0], lm[1]) for lm in h.landmarks]\n47\t        if len(pts) < 21:\n48\t            return GestureReading(\"neutral\", 0.0)\n49\t        wrist = pts[0]\n50\t        span = _dist(pts[0], pts[9]) or 1e-6\n51\t        extended = [_dist(pts[t], wrist) > _dist(pts[p], wrist) for t, p in zip(_TIPS, _PIPS)]\n52\t        n = sum(extended)\n53\t        pinch = _dist(pts[4], pts[8]) < 0.35 * span       # thumb-tip near index-tip\n54\t        if pinch and n <= 2:\n55\t            return GestureReading(\"pinch\", 0.9, margin=0.5)\n56\t        if n == 0:\n57\t            return GestureReading(\"fist\", 0.9, margin=0.5)\n58\t        if n >= 4:\n59\t            return GestureReading(\"open\", 0.9, margin=0.5)\n60\t        if extended[1] and n == 1:                        # index only → point (pointer driver)\n61\t            return GestureReading(\"point\", 0.9, dx=0.0, dy=0.0, margin=0.4)\n62\t        return GestureReading(\"neutral\", 0.3, margin=0.1)\n63\t"}]},"uuid":"a59416c7-fc36-4157-8e23-de9103f06ef4","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:11.578Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b60fb093-8b0c-4268-b1de-3b6623b20660","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"25c46af3-ca86-41a3-bf39-82a69aab0b62","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdAQaqMfEWfSwywic6ZjQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KzY2dk43Jc8rnFMDeCA4LA","name":"Read","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/tests/test_gesture.py"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":8949,"cache_read_input_tokens":29028,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":8949,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdAQapAyPvk77D7HjTfce","attributionAgent":"general-purpose","type":"assistant","uuid":"f312f93a-df8d-4c20-9da0-5cdce158d5b4","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:11.728Z","effort":"xhigh","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"25c46af3-ca86-41a3-bf39-82a69aab0b62","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01M5iVJBDiWqvxBz2n1o1mD2","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Persistent low-latency camera stream (Phase 8, WS-F F2) — a `voice.backends.MicAudioSource`-style\n2\tgenerator over ONE warm `ffmpeg` rawvideo pipe. Unlike `capture.grab_camera` (which cold-starts an\n3\tffmpeg process + writes a PNG + OCRs PER FRAME — hundreds of ms, unusable for control), this keeps the\n4\tdevice handle open and reads raw RGB frames off stdout. Drop-to-latest so inference never queues\n5\tbehind a slow frame. Honest-empty (no frames) if ffmpeg/device/numpy absent — never a fabricated\n6\tframe. `grab_camera` is left untouched (backward-compatible single-shot).\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport shutil\n10\timport subprocess\n11\tfrom pathlib import Path\n12\tfrom typing import Iterator, List, Optional\n13\t\n14\t\n15\tclass CameraStreamSource:\n16\t    def __init__(self, device: str = \"/dev/video0\", width: int = 640, height: int = 480, fps: int = 30):\n17\t        self.device, self.width, self.height, self.fps = device, width, height, fps\n18\t\n19\t    def available(self) -> bool:\n20\t        return bool(shutil.which(\"ffmpeg\")) and Path(self.device).exists()\n21\t\n22\t    def frames(self) -> Iterator:\n23\t        \"\"\"Yield raw RGB frames (numpy HxWx3 uint8) from a single warm ffmpeg process. Ends silently\n24\t        if unavailable.\"\"\"\n25\t        if not self.available():\n26\t            return\n27\t        try:\n28\t            import numpy as np\n29\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no numpy → no stream (honest)\n30\t            return\n31\t        frame_bytes = self.width * self.height * 3\n32\t        proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None\n33\t        try:\n34\t            proc = subprocess.Popen(\n35\t                [\"ffmpeg\", \"-loglevel\", \"quiet\", \"-f\", \"v4l2\", \"-i\", self.device,\n36\t                 \"-f\", \"rawvideo\", \"-pix_fmt\", \"rgb24\", \"-s\", f\"{self.width}x{self.height}\",\n37\t                 \"-r\", str(self.fps), \"pipe:1\"],\n38\t                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n39\t            while True:\n40\t                buf = proc.stdout.read(frame_bytes)\n41\t                if not buf or len(buf) < frame_bytes:\n42\t                    break\n43\t                yield np.frombuffer(buf, dtype=np.uint8).reshape((self.height, self.width, 3))\n44\t        except (OSError, ValueError):\n45\t            return\n46\t        finally:\n47\t            if proc is not None:\n48\t                proc.terminate()\n49\t                try:\n50\t                    proc.wait(timeout=2)\n51\t                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n52\t                    proc.kill()\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tclass ScriptedFrameSource:\n56\t    \"\"\"Deterministic double — yields a fixed list of frames (ndarrays or any placeholder). No device.\"\"\"\n57\t    def __init__(self, frames: List):\n58\t        self._frames = list(frames)\n59\t\n60\t    def available(self) -> bool:\n61\t        return True\n62\t\n63\t    def frames(self) -> Iterator:\n64\t        yield from self._frames\n65\t"}]},"uuid":"1e75f48e-06c2-426b-b631-b4a932ce750d","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:41:11.780Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"25c46af3-ca86-41a3-bf39-82a69aab0b62","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"f312f93a-df8d-4c20-9da0-5cdce158d5b4","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"aa4416bc-1e6f-4bd3-a4a5-674e541f55e9","agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01KzY2dk43Jc8rnFMDeCA4LA","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SIGIL Phase 8 WS-F — SIGIL-HAND gesture control: debounced fail-safe FSM, invariant landmark\n2\tfeatures, and THE KEYSTONE — injection only inside an owner-armed session, A2 actions queued (a\n3\tgesture can never type a password or launch an app). Run: ~/.sigil/venv/bin/python tests/test_gesture.py\"\"\"\n4\timport math\n5\timport tempfile\n6\tfrom pathlib import Path\n7\t\n8\tfrom sigil.agents.base import Tier\n9\tfrom sigil.gesture import GesturePipeline, Session, SessionGate\n10\tfrom sigil.gesture.components import RecordingInputBackend, ScriptedGestures, ScriptedLandmarker\n11\tfrom sigil.gesture.features import RuleClassifier, invariant_features\n12\tfrom sigil.gesture.run import run_gesture\n13\tfrom sigil.gesture.types import GestureIntent, GestureReading, Hand\n14\tfrom sigil.perception.camera_stream import ScriptedFrameSource\n15\tfrom sigil.reuse import generate_keypair\n16\tfrom sigil.spine.store import SpineStore\n17\t\n18\tOWNER = generate_keypair()\n19\tOP = OWNER.public_key_b64\n20\t\n21\t\n22\tdef _store():\n23\t    return SpineStore(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".jsonl\"))\n24\t\n25\t\n26\tclass FakeCls:\n27\t    \"\"\"hid.pointer.* → A1 (inject); everything else → A2 (queue). Deterministic stand-in for the oracle.\"\"\"\n28\t    def classify(self, tool):\n29\t        return Tier.A1 if tool.startswith(\"hid.pointer\") else Tier.A2\n30\t\n31\t\n32\t# ---- F0 FSM: debounce + fail-safe ----------------------------------------------------------------\n33\tdef test_fsm_requires_confirm_frames_and_is_failsafe_on_ambiguity():\n34\t    p = GesturePipeline(confirm_frames=3, margin_min=0.15, conf_min=0.6)\n35\t    hi = GestureReading(\"pinch\", 0.9, margin=0.5)\n36\t    assert p.on_frame(hi) is None and p.on_frame(hi) is None, \"one/two frames fire nothing (hysteresis)\"\n37\t    fired = p.on_frame(hi)\n38\t    assert fired and fired.kind == \"click\", \"3 consecutive confident pinches fire a click\"\n39\t    # low margin → treated as neutral → nothing fires, streak resets\n40\t    p2 = GesturePipeline(confirm_frames=2, margin_min=0.2)\n41\t    p2.on_frame(GestureReading(\"pinch\", 0.9, margin=0.5))\n42\t    assert p2.on_frame(GestureReading(\"pinch\", 0.9, margin=0.05)) is None, \"an ambiguous (low-margin) frame does nothing\"\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tdef test_fsm_hand_lost_disarms_and_point_moves():\n46\t    p = GesturePipeline(hand_lost_frames=2)\n47\t    assert p.on_frame(None) is None\n48\t    hl = p.on_frame(None)\n49\t    assert hl and hl.kind == \"hand_lost\", \"sustained no-hand emits a disarm signal\"\n50\t    p2 = GesturePipeline(deadzone=0.001)\n51\t    mv = p2.on_frame(GestureReading(\"point\", 0.9, dx=0.5, dy=0.2, margin=0.4))\n52\t    assert mv and mv.kind == \"move\" and mv.dx == 0.5, \"a point pose drives pointer movement\"\n53\t    assert p2.on_frame(GestureReading(\"point\", 0.9, dx=0.0, dy=0.0, margin=0.4)) is None, \"sub-deadzone → no move\"\n54\t\n55\t\n56\t# ---- F4 feature invariance -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n57\tdef test_features_are_translation_scale_rotation_invariant():\n58\t    base = Hand(tuple((math.cos(i) * 0.1 + 0.5, math.sin(i) * 0.1 + 0.5, 0.0) for i in range(21)))\n59\t    f0 = invariant_features(base)\n60\t    translated = Hand(tuple((x + 0.3, y - 0.2, z) for x, y, z in base.landmarks))\n61\t    scaled = Hand(tuple((x * 2.0, y * 2.0, z) for x, y, z in base.landmarks))\n62\t    th, c, s = 0.7, math.cos(0.7), math.sin(0.7)\n63\t    rotated = Hand(tuple((x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c, z) for x, y, z in base.landmarks))\n64\t    for h, name in ((translated, \"translate\"), (scaled, \"scale\"), (rotated, \"rotate\")):\n65\t        f = invariant_features(h)\n66\t        assert max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(f0, f)) < 1e-6, f\"features must be invariant to {name}\"\n67\t\n68\t\n69\tdef test_rule_classifier_reads_poses():\n70\t    fist = Hand(tuple((0.5, 0.5, 0) for _ in range(21)))            # all tips near wrist → fist\n71\t    assert RuleClassifier().classify([fist]).label in (\"fist\", \"pinch\")\n72\t    assert RuleClassifier().classify([]).label == \"neutral\", \"no hand → neutral\"\n73\t\n74\t\n75\t# ---- F6 THE KEYSTONE: armed session + tier gate --------------------------------------------------\n76\tdef test_injection_only_inside_an_armed_session():\n77\t    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n78\t    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls())\n79\t    r = g.handle(GestureIntent(\"move\", dx=3, dy=2))\n80\t    assert r[\"injected\"] is False and \"no armed session\" in r[\"reason\"] and not b.calls, \"no session → NO injection\"\n81\t    g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)\n82\t    r = g.handle(GestureIntent(\"move\", dx=3, dy=2))\n83\t    assert r[\"injected\"] is True and (\"move\", 3, 2) in b.calls, \"A1 pointer move injects within the session\"\n84\t    g.disarm()\n85\t    assert g.handle(GestureIntent(\"click\"))[\"injected\"] is False, \"disarm stops injection\"\n86\t\n87\t\n88\tdef test_a2_gesture_actions_queue_never_inject():\n89\t    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n90\t    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls())\n91\t    g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)\n92\t    r = g.handle(GestureIntent(\"type\", arg=\"my-password\"))\n93\t    assert r[\"injected\"] is False and \"queued\" in r, \"a keystroke gesture QUEUES, never auto-injects\"\n94\t    assert not any(c[0] == \"type\" for c in b.calls), \"a gesture can NEVER type a password on its own\"\n95\t    r2 = g.handle(GestureIntent(\"launch\", arg=\"terminal\"))\n96\t    assert r2[\"injected\"] is False and \"queued\" in r2, \"an app-launch gesture QUEUES for approval\"\n97\t    # {"parentUuid":"4d5fed1f-61b2-4643-bf7e-728583182aed","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdAQy36DWNtXzvmA32xmV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XpZBAvBDm54sm92Q8VbzVA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/remote.py","content":"\"\"\"Phone-as-gesture-trackpad landmark stream (Phase 9, W2-I). The PHONE runs its OWN on-device hand-\nlandmark detection and streams tiny `List[Hand]` batches (landmark DATA, never owner pixels) to the PC\nover the owner's own tunnel; the PC feeds them through the EXISTING gesture pipeline. This slice streams\ninto a LOCAL owner-armed session ONLY — the owner arms at the PC (`run_gesture(auto_arm=False, gate=<armed>)`)\nand the phone supplies landmarks. The device-signed REMOTE arm is a SEPARATE, later-authorized slice and\nis deliberately NOT built here.\n\nDesign (mirrors the on-box components; NO dependency on `sigil/bridge/` — an inbound batch iterable is\nINJECTED, so there is no socket/import coupling here):\n\n  • `decode_hand_batch(obj) -> List[Hand]` — parse+VALIDATE the compact wire form; on ANY malformation\n    return an HONEST `[]` (never a fabricated hand), exactly as `OnnxHandLandmarker.detect` returns `[]`\n    on failure.\n  • `RemoteLandmarkSource` — the frame source: wraps the injected inbound feed, drops foreign-session /\n    replayed / reordered / stale batches, and yields ONE token (the decoded `List[Hand]`) per ACCEPTED\n    batch. It tracks only a single last-accepted `seq` (a bounded int — no unbounded buffer), and because\n    `seq` is strictly monotonic an out-of-order (older) batch arriving after a newer one is dropped\n    (drop-to-latest).\n  • `RemoteLandmarker` — a `LandmarkModel` with `egresses = False` (HONEST: it uploads NO owner pixels;\n    the phone already did the inference and sends inbound landmark DATA). `detect(token)` returns the\n    token's hands, ignoring any image.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport time\nfrom typing import Iterable, Iterator, List, Optional\n\nfrom .types import Hand\n\nWIRE_TYPE = \"hand_batch\"\nMAX_HANDS = 2\nN_LANDMARKS = 21\n_COORD_CAP = 8.0          # sane bound: reject NaN/inf/garbage coordinates (normalized hands live near [0,1])\n\n\ndef _is_number(v) -> bool:\n    # a real, finite number — bools are ints in Python, so exclude them explicitly\n    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(float(v))\n\n\ndef _valid_coord(v) -> bool:\n    return _is_number(v) and abs(float(v)) <= _COORD_CAP\n\n\ndef decode_hand_batch(obj) -> List[Hand]:\n    \"\"\"Decode a compact wire batch to `List[Hand]`, VALIDATING strictly. Wire form:\n\n        {\"t\":\"hand_batch\",\"session_id\":str,\"seq\":int,\"ts\":float,\n         \"hands\":[ {\"l\":[[x,y,z] × 21], \"h\":\"R\"|\"L\", \"s\":score}, ... ≤ 2 ]}\n\n    Rules (any violation ⇒ return `[]`, honest-empty — never fabricate):\n      • obj is a dict tagged `\"t\":\"hand_batch\"`;\n      • `hands` is a list of AT MOST 2 hands;\n      • each hand has EXACTLY 21 landmarks, each a 3-tuple of finite, sane (|v|≤8) floats;\n      • handedness `h` ∈ {\"R\",\"L\"} (→ \"Right\"/\"Left\"), defaulting \"R\" only when the key is absent;\n      • score `s` a finite float in [0,1], defaulting 1.0 only when the key is absent.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        if not isinstance(obj, dict) or obj.get(\"t\") != WIRE_TYPE:\n            return []\n        raw_hands = obj.get(\"hands\")\n        if not isinstance(raw_hands, list) or len(raw_hands) > MAX_HANDS:\n            return []\n        out: List[Hand] = []\n        for rh in raw_hands:\n            if not isinstance(rh, dict):\n                return []\n            lms = rh.get(\"l\")\n            if not isinstance(lms, (list, tuple)) or len(lms) != N_LANDMARKS:\n                return []\n            pts: List[tuple] = []\n            for p in lms:\n                if not isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) or len(p) != 3:\n                    return []\n                if not (_valid_coord(p[0]) and _valid_coord(p[1]) and _valid_coord(p[2])):\n                    return []\n                pts.append((float(p[0]), float(p[1]), float(p[2])))\n            h = rh.get(\"h\", \"R\")\n            if h not in (\"R\", \"L\"):\n                return []\n            handed = \"Right\" if h == \"R\" else \"Left\"\n            s = rh.get(\"s\", 1.0)\n            if not _is_number(s) or not (0.0 <= float(s) <= 1.0):\n                return []\n            out.append(Hand(landmarks=tuple(pts), handedness=handed, score=float(s)))\n        return out\n    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — ANY malformation ⇒ honest empty (mirror OnnxHandLandmarker.detect)\n        return []\n\n\nclass ScriptedRemoteSource:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic double — an injected inbound feed of raw wire dicts (no socket, no `bridge`).\n    Mirrors `perception.camera_stream.ScriptedFrameSource`: replays a fixed list of batch objects.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, batches: Iterable):\n        self._batches = list(batches)\n\n    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator:\n        return iter(self._batches)\n\n\nclass RemoteLandmarkSource:\n    \"\"\"Frame source over an INJECTED inbound batch feed, bound to the LIVE local session.\n\n    `frames()` yields ONE token (the decoded `List[Hand]`) per ACCEPTED batch. A batch is REJECTED\n    (dropped, never fabricated) when its `session_id` ≠ the live session, its `seq` ≤ the last accepted\n    `seq` (duplicate / reorder / replay), or — if a freshness window is set — its `ts` is outside it.\n    The paired `RemoteLandmarker` returns the yielded token, so the token IS the landmark payload.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, inbound: Iterable, session_id: str, *,\n                 freshness_seconds: Optional[float] = None, now=time.time):\n        self._inbound = inbound\n        self.session_id = session_id\n        self._freshness = freshness_seconds\n        self._now = now\n        self._last_seq: Optional[int] = None   # bounded: a single int, never an unbounded accepted-set\n\n    def available(self) -> bool:\n        return True\n\n    def _accept(self, obj) -> Optional[List[Hand]]:\n        \"\"\"Return the decoded hands for an ACCEPTED batch, or None if the batch is rejected.\"\"\"\n        if not isinstance(obj, dict) or obj.get(\"t\") != WIRE_TYPE:\n            return None\n        if obj.get(\"session_id\") != self.session_id:            # foreign session → drop\n            return None\n        seq = obj.get(\"seq\")\n        if not isinstance(seq, int) or isinstance(seq, bool):   # seq must be a real int\n            return None\n        if self._last_seq is not None and seq <= self._last_seq:   # replay / reorder / duplicate → drop\n            return None\n        if self._freshness is not None:                          # optional freshness window\n            ts = obj.get(\"ts\")\n            if not _is_number(ts) or abs(self._now() - float(ts)) > self._freshness:\n                return None\n        hands = decode_hand_batch(obj)   # may be [] (honest) — a valid envelope with malformed hands\n        self._last_seq = seq             # advance ONLY once the batch is accepted at the envelope level\n        return hands\n\n    def frames(self) -> Iterator[List[Hand]]:\n        for obj in self._inbound:\n            hands = self._accept(obj)\n            if hands is None:            # rejected — note: [] is ACCEPTED (honest no-hand), None is not\n                continue\n            yield hands\n\n\nclass RemoteLandmarker:\n    \"\"\"A `LandmarkModel` fed by the phone's OWN on-device inference. `egresses = False` is HONEST —\n    it uploads NO owner pixels; the inbound stream is landmark DATA over the owner's own tunnel. Because\n    `egresses is False`, the Wave-1 fail-closed egress gate in `run_gesture` PASSES it (reconciliation:\n    that gate refuses a model that would EGRESS owner imagery; this one egresses nothing).\"\"\"\n\n    egresses = False\n    source_kind = \"remote_device_stream\"\n\n    def detect(self, token) -> List[Hand]:\n        # `token` is the decoded List[Hand] yielded by RemoteLandmarkSource.frames(); return it as-is,\n        # ignoring any image (the phone already produced these landmarks). Honest-empty otherwise.\n        if isinstance(token, list):\n            return token\n        return []\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":810,"cache_read_input_tokens":73719,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":810,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CdAQxuxM15n4Ar7m2pCXQ","attributionAgent":"general-purpose","type":"assistant","uuid":"4c6e2146-cf06-4b35-b0c0-a77b5437c24c","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:46:46.789Z","effort":"xhigh","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"a6381544-dbf5-4235-938a-972b4e236a4e","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a52eecb4665b20409","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdAR3vEbafqbifY7QE1LK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JvrJ6R8ZKj8JVHxWxCgRUR","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/kali/sigil/tests/test_gesture_remote.py","content":"\"\"\"SIGIL Phase 9 W2-I — phone-as-gesture-trackpad landmark stream. The phone runs its OWN on-device\nlandmark detection and streams tiny List[Hand] batches to the PC; the PC feeds them through the EXISTING\ngesture pipeline, into a LOCAL owner-armed session ONLY. These tests prove: the remote path NEVER bypasses\nLayer-1 (an unarmed session injects nothing); a `point` stream drives pointer `move` (A1) inside a local\nowner-armed session; malformation decodes to an honest `[]`; and replayed/reordered/foreign-session batches\nare dropped (no re-processing, no cross-session injection). A launch/type-class intent still QUEUES via the\nsame SessionGate (never auto-injects). Run: ~/.sigil/venv/bin/python tests/test_gesture_remote.py\"\"\"\nimport tempfile\nimport time\n\nfrom sigil.agents.base import Tier\nfrom sigil.gesture.components import RecordingInputBackend\nfrom sigil.gesture.features import RuleClassifier\nfrom sigil.gesture.pipeline import GesturePipeline\nfrom sigil.gesture.remote import (RemoteLandmarker, RemoteLandmarkSource, ScriptedRemoteSource,\n                                  decode_hand_batch)\nfrom sigil.gesture.run import run_gesture\nfrom sigil.gesture.session import SessionGate\nfrom sigil.gesture.types import GestureIntent, Hand\nfrom sigil.reuse import generate_keypair\nfrom sigil.spine.store import SpineStore\n\nOWNER = generate_keypair()\n\n\ndef _store():\n    return SpineStore(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".jsonl\"))\n\n\nclass FakeCls:\n    \"\"\"hid.pointer.* → A1 (inject); everything else → A2 (queue). The oracle stand-in test_gesture.py uses.\"\"\"\n    def classify(self, tool):\n        return Tier.A1 if tool.startswith(\"hid.pointer\") else Tier.A2\n\n\n# --- crafted landmark geometry the REAL RuleClassifier reads --------------------------------------\n# A POINT pose: index extended (tip8 farther from wrist than pip6), all other fingers curled, thumb NOT\n# near the index tip → RuleClassifier returns \"point\" (n==1, extended index, pinch False).\nPOINT_LM = [\n    (0.50, 0.90, 0.0),                                       # 0  wrist\n    (0.44, 0.82, 0.0), (0.40, 0.72, 0.0), (0.44, 0.76, 0.0), (0.48, 0.78, 0.0),   # 1-4  thumb (curled)\n    (0.55, 0.60, 0.0), (0.55, 0.45, 0.0), (0.55, 0.35, 0.0), (0.55, 0.25, 0.0),   # 5-8  index (extended)\n    (0.50, 0.60, 0.0), (0.50, 0.50, 0.0), (0.50, 0.58, 0.0), (0.50, 0.66, 0.0),   # 9-12 middle (curled)\n    (0.45, 0.60, 0.0), (0.45, 0.50, 0.0), (0.45, 0.58, 0.0), (0.45, 0.66, 0.0),   # 13-16 ring (curled)\n    (0.40, 0.60, 0.0), (0.40, 0.50, 0.0), (0.40, 0.58, 0.0), (0.40, 0.66, 0.0),   # 17-20 pinky (curled)\n]\n# A PINCH pose: all keypoints coincident → thumb-tip meets index-tip, no finger extended → \"pinch\".\nPINCH_LM = [(0.5, 0.5, 0.0)] * 21\n\n\ndef _batch(session_id, seq, landmarks, *, ts=0.0, h=\"R\", s=0.9):\n    return {\"t\": \"hand_batch\", \"session_id\": session_id, \"seq\": seq, \"ts\": ts,\n            \"hands\": [{\"l\": [list(p) for p in landmarks], \"h\": h, \"s\": s}]}\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# decode_hand_batch — strict validation, honest-empty on malformation\n# =================================================================================================\ndef test_decode_hand_batch_valid_roundtrips_to_hands():\n    hands = decode_hand_batch(_batch(\"S\", 0, POINT_LM, h=\"L\", s=0.8))\n    assert len(hands) == 1 and isinstance(hands[0], Hand)\n    assert len(hands[0].landmarks) == 21 and hands[0].landmarks[8] == (0.55, 0.25, 0.0)\n    assert hands[0].handedness == \"Left\" and abs(hands[0].score - 0.8) < 1e-9\n    # RuleClassifier reads the decoded geometry as a real \"point\" pose\n    assert RuleClassifier().classify(hands).label == \"point\", \"the crafted geometry classifies as point\"\n\n\ndef test_decode_hand_batch_is_honest_empty_on_any_malformation():\n    good = _batch(\"S\", 0, POINT_LM)\n    assert decode_hand_batch(good), \"sanity: the well-formed batch decodes\"\n    bad_cases = {\n        \"not-a-dict\": \"nope\",\n        \"wrong-type-tag\": {**good, \"t\": \"other\"},\n        \"no-hands-key\": {\"t\": \"hand_batch\", \"session_id\": \"S\", \"seq\": 0, \"ts\": 0.0},\n        \"too-many-hands\": {**good, \"hands\": [good[\"hands\"][0]] * 3},          # > 2 hands\n        \"20-landmarks\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\", \"s\": 0.9}]},\n        \"22-landmarks\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 22, \"h\": \"R\", \"s\": 0.9}]},\n        \"landmark-not-triple\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[0.5, 0.5]] + [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\"}]},\n        \"non-numeric-coord\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[\"x\", 0.5, 0.0]] + [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\"}]},\n        \"nan-coord\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[float(\"nan\"), 0.5, 0.0]] + [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\"}]},\n        \"inf-coord\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[float(\"inf\"), 0.5, 0.0]] + [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\"}]},\n        \"insane-coord\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[999.0, 0.5, 0.0]] + [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\"}]},\n        \"bad-handedness\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [list(p) for p in POINT_LM], \"h\": \"Z\", \"s\": 0.9}]},\n        \"score-out-of-range\": {**good, \"hands\": [{\"l\": [list(p) for p in POINT_LM], \"h\": \"R\", \"s\": 5.0}]},\n    }\n    for name, obj in bad_cases.items():\n        assert decode_hand_batch(obj) == [], f\"malformed batch [{name}] must decode to honest []\"\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# RemoteLandmarkSource — foreign-session / replay / reorder / freshness dropping\n# =================================================================================================\ndef test_foreign_session_id_batches_are_dropped():\n    sid = \"S-live\"\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([\n        _batch(\"S-attacker\", 0, POINT_LM),   # foreign session → dropped\n        _batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM),            # ours → accepted\n        _batch(\"S-attacker\", 1, POINT_LM),   # foreign session → dropped\n    ]), session_id=sid)\n    assert len(list(src.frames())) == 1, \"only batches bound to the live session are yielded\"\n\n\ndef test_replayed_and_reordered_seq_batches_are_dropped():\n    sid = \"S-live\"\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([\n        _batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM),\n        _batch(sid, 1, POINT_LM),\n        _batch(sid, 1, POINT_LM),   # duplicate seq → dropped (replay)\n        _batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM),   # older seq after a newer one → dropped (reorder/replay)\n        _batch(sid, 2, POINT_LM),\n    ]), session_id=sid)\n    assert len(list(src.frames())) == 3, \"seq 0,1,2 accepted; the duplicate/older seqs are dropped\"\n\n\ndef test_stale_batch_outside_freshness_window_is_dropped():\n    sid = \"S-live\"\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([\n        _batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM, ts=900.0),    # 100s old vs a 5s window → stale, dropped\n        _batch(sid, 1, POINT_LM, ts=1000.0),   # fresh\n    ]), session_id=sid, freshness_seconds=5.0, now=lambda: 1000.0)\n    assert len(list(src.frames())) == 1, \"a batch outside the freshness window is dropped\"\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# RemoteLandmarker — on-box-honest, passes the Wave-1 egress gate\n# =================================================================================================\ndef test_remote_landmarker_is_on_box_honest_and_passes_the_egress_gate():\n    lm = RemoteLandmarker()\n    assert lm.egresses is False and lm.source_kind == \"remote_device_stream\"\n    hands = decode_hand_batch(_batch(\"S\", 0, POINT_LM))\n    assert lm.detect(hands) is hands, \"detect returns the token's hands (the phone already inferred them)\"\n    assert lm.detect(\"not-a-list\") == [], \"honest-empty on a non-list token\"\n    # the loop's fail-closed egress gate refuses an EGRESSING model but PASSES this egresses=False one:\n    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n    sid = \"S-egress\"\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([_batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM)]), session_id=sid)\n    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls(), owner_key=OWNER); g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)\n    # rebind the source to the real session id so a frame is delivered\n    src.session_id = g.session.session_id\n    n = run_gesture(store=s, owner_key=OWNER, source=src, landmarker=lm, classifier=RuleClassifier(),\n                    backend=b, gate=g, pipeline=GesturePipeline(deadzone=0.0), auto_arm=False)\n    assert n == 0 or n >= 0  # loop ran (not refused); no gesture.refused record was appended\n    assert not any(r.payload.get(\"signal\") == \"gesture.refused\" for r in s.iter_records()), \\\n        \"a RemoteLandmarker (egresses=False) is NOT refused by the egress gate\"\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# End-to-end: the KEYSTONE — remote stream cannot bypass the owner-armed session\n# =================================================================================================\ndef test_remote_stream_into_an_UNARMED_session_injects_nothing():\n    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n    sid = \"S-unarmed\"\n    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls(), owner_key=OWNER)   # NOT armed\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([\n        _batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM), _batch(sid, 1, POINT_LM), _batch(sid, 2, POINT_LM),\n    ]), session_id=sid)\n    n = run_gesture(store=s, owner_key=OWNER, source=src, landmarker=RemoteLandmarker(),\n                    classifier=RuleClassifier(), backend=b, gate=g,\n                    pipeline=GesturePipeline(deadzone=0.0), auto_arm=False)\n    assert n == 3, \"the source delivered valid frames and the loop processed them\"\n    assert b.calls == [], \"but with NO armed session the remote stream injects NOTHING (Layer-1 holds)\"\n    assert not any(r.payload.get(\"signal\") == \"gesture.session_armed\" for r in s.iter_records()), \\\n        \"auto_arm=False + an unarmed gate never arms a session\"\n\n\ndef test_remote_point_stream_moves_in_a_LOCAL_owner_armed_session():\n    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls(), owner_key=OWNER)\n    sess = g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)                                  # owner arms LOCALLY at the PC\n    sid = sess.session_id\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([\n        _batch(sid, 0, POINT_LM), _batch(sid, 1, POINT_LM), _batch(sid, 2, POINT_LM),\n    ]), session_id=sid)\n    n = run_gesture(store=s, owner_key=OWNER, source=src, landmarker=RemoteLandmarker(),\n                    classifier=RuleClassifier(), backend=b, gate=g,\n                    pipeline=GesturePipeline(deadzone=0.0), auto_arm=False)\n    assert n == 3\n    moves = [c for c in b.calls if c[0] == \"move\"]\n    assert moves, \"a point stream drives pointer MOVE (A1) injections inside the local owner-armed session\"\n    assert all(c[0] == \"move\" for c in b.calls), \"a point stream only moves — no click/type/etc.\"\n    # the session was disarmed in the finally (indicator cleared)\n    assert any(r.payload.get(\"signal\") == \"gesture.session_disarmed\" for r in s.iter_records())\n\n\ndef test_remote_pinch_stream_clicks_in_a_LOCAL_owner_armed_session():\n    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls(), owner_key=OWNER)\n    sess = g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)\n    sid = sess.session_id\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([\n        _batch(sid, 0, PINCH_LM), _batch(sid, 1, PINCH_LM), _batch(sid, 2, PINCH_LM),\n    ]), session_id=sid)\n    run_gesture(store=s, owner_key=OWNER, source=src, landmarker=RemoteLandmarker(),\n                classifier=RuleClassifier(), backend=b, gate=g,\n                pipeline=GesturePipeline(confirm_frames=3, deadzone=0.0), auto_arm=False)\n    assert any(c[0] == \"click\" for c in b.calls), \"3 confirmed pinch batches fire a click (A1) end-to-end\"\n\n\ndef test_malformed_remote_batch_injects_nothing_end_to_end():\n    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls(), owner_key=OWNER)\n    sess = g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)\n    sid = sess.session_id\n    # valid envelope (so the source reaches decode) but MALFORMED hands (20 landmarks) → decode [] → nothing\n    malformed = {\"t\": \"hand_batch\", \"session_id\": sid, \"seq\": 0, \"ts\": 0.0,\n                 \"hands\": [{\"l\": [[0.5, 0.5, 0.0]] * 20, \"h\": \"R\", \"s\": 0.9}]}\n    src = RemoteLandmarkSource(ScriptedRemoteSource([malformed]), session_id=sid)\n    n = run_gesture(store=s, owner_key=OWNER, source=src, landmarker=RemoteLandmarker(),\n                    classifier=RuleClassifier(), backend=b, gate=g,\n                    pipeline=GesturePipeline(deadzone=0.0), auto_arm=False)\n    assert n == 1, \"the envelope was valid so the loop ran once\"\n    assert b.calls == [], \"a malformed batch decodes to [] → the pipeline emits nothing → no injection\"\n\n\ndef test_foreign_session_batch_never_injects_in_an_armed_session():\n    s = _store(); b = RecordingInputBackend()\n    g = SessionGate(s, b, classifier=FakeCls(), owner_key=OWNER)\n    sess = g.arm(owner_key=OWNER)\n    #
